title: A drain stops on repeated install failures (exit 71)
body:
Evidence: #1458 (32e764d) added exit 71 for a failed contract install before the session; src/cli/lane-run/drain.ts infrastructureExits does not list 71, so a drain on a host whose install fails keeps starting tasks that all fail the same way.
Outcome: exit 71 counts as an infrastructure exit in the drain stop rule.
Files: src/cli/lane-run/drain.ts, test/cli/lane-drain.test.ts
Proof: a drain test with two consecutive install failures stops after the second.
